[pūjā paddhati] || (******)(?) puṣvabhājana || oṃ adyādi || (**)(?) || mānavagotra yajamānasya śrīśrījaya bhūpatīndramalla varvaṇaḥ śrīśrīkulacakreśvarī devatā pītyarthaṃ viśvajātrā mahādīpa prajvalita pañcopacārapūjākatuṃ puṣpabhājanaṃ samarpayāmi || śrīsamvartāmaṇḍalānte kramapadanihitā nandaśaktiḥ subhīmāsṛṣṭaṃ nyāya catuskaṃ akulakulagataṃ paṃcakaṃ cānyaṣaṭkaṃ || catvaraḥ pañcakonyaṃ punarapi caturaṃ tatvato maṇḍalena saṃsṛṣṭaṃ yena tasmai namataguruvaraṃ bhairava śrīkujeśa || <1b> vrahmāṇī kamalendu saumyavadanī māheśvarī lirayā kaumārī ripudarpanāsanakarī cakrāyudhāvaiṣṇavī || vārāhī ghanaghoragharghanamukhī aindrī ca vajrāyudhā cāmuṇḍā gaṇanāthabhairavagaṇā rakṣantume mātṛkā || śyāmāraktā trinetrā stanabharaṇamitā mattamāḍhaṃ agāmi vimvosthi cārunetrā pṛthutarajaghanā mekharā ratnasobhe || devāge vastrasobhe varavarakusume varvarekeśabhāre sāmeśrīkuvjikākhyā citaratutarasājñānadi vyoghamogha ||
<2a> utphullāmvuja karṇikoparigatā śrīsiddhilakṣmī parākarghure phaṭikendukuṇḍadhavarā niśrekapāpopahā | saṃsārātnavaduḥ khapaṃkajahari niṣkampamaṃ sarvadā śrīmatpañcamukhāmvujā daśabhujā pretasthitā pātu va || raktavarṇacaturvāhu akṣamālā triśūlakaṃ | kapālaṃ vindu hastā ca cakreśvarī namostute || siddhirastu kriyārambhe vṛddhirastu dhanāgame || puṣṭirastu śarīreṣu śāntirastu gṛhe tava || sarvavighni praśamanaṃ sarvaśānti karaṃ śubhaṃ || āyuḥ putra ca kāmaṃ ca lakṣmīḥ santati vardhanaṃ yathā vānaprahārāṇāṃ kavacaṃ bhavatu vāraṇaṃ tadvadeva vidhātrāṇāṃ śānti bhava tu vāraṇaṃ || <2b> (******)(?) samaghayāmiḥ || (**)(?) ātmatatvāya svāhā || aiṁ (5)hrīṁ vidyātatvāya svāhā || aiṁ (5)hūṁ śivatatvāya svāhā || gurunamaskāra || aiṁ (5)akhaṇḍamaṇḍalākālaṃ vyāptaṃ yena carācaraṃ || tatpadaṃ daśitaṃ yena tasmai śrīguruve namaḥ || aiṁ (5)guruvrahmā guruviṣṇu gurudevamaheśvaraṃ || gurudeva jagatsarvaṃ tasmai śrīguruve namaḥ || paramagurubhyo namaḥ || parameṣṭīgurubhyo namaḥ || paramācārya murubhyo namaḥ || vali ||
<3a> padmāsanāya namaḥ || (**)(?) kūrmāsanāya pādukāṃ || nyāsa || aiṁ (5)kiṇi (2)vicce koṅkaṇāyai hraḥ astrāya phaṭ || aiṁ (5)hūṁ phaṭ vajrapañjare svāhā || calamakulekulamacale hrīṁ hūṁ phaṭ svāhā || nyāsaḥ || aṃ astrāya phaṭ || 4 || kalaśodhanaṃ || aiṁ aṃguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ || hrīṁ tarjanībhyāṃ namaḥ || śrīṁ madhyamābhyāṃ namaḥ || hsphreṁ anāmikābhyāṃ namaḥ || hsauṁ kaniṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ || aṃ astrāya karatalapṛṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ || aiṁ hṛdayāya namaḥ || hrīṁ śirase svāhā || śrīṁ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ || hsphreṁ kavacāya hūṃ || hsauṁ netratrayāya vauṣaṭ || aṁ astrāya phaṭ || <3b>(***)tra pūjā || hakāra kuṭana pūjā || hrā hadayādi || āvāhanādi dhenumudrāṃ || gāyatrī || aiṁ (5)kubjikāyai vidmahe kuradīpāyai dhīmahe tannḥ kuvjipracodayāt || arghapātra pūjā || arghapātra svāhā svāhā namaḥ || (******)(?) || hrāṁ hrīṁ hrūṁ hraḥ prasphura (2)ghora (2)taratanu (2)rupacaṭa (2)pracaṭa (2) kaha (2)vama (2)dama (2)ghāṭaya (2)vighāṭaya (2)vighni (2)hūṁ (3)phaṭ krauṁ śrīmāhākaumāri vicce pādukāṃ || aiṁ (5)śkṣmlvryīṁ ānandaśakti bhairavānanda śrīmahāvidyā rājeśvarī hskṣmlvryūṁ śrīarghapātra bhaṭṭārikāya pādukāṃ ||
<4a> ṣaḍaṃga || aiṁ hṛdayāya namaḥ || hrīṁ śirase svāhā || śrīṁ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ || hsphreṁ kavacāya hūṁ || hskauṁ netratrayāya vauṣaṭ || aṃ astrāya phaṭ || āvāhanādi || yonimudrāṃ darśayet || bhūtaśuddhi || aiṁ hrīṁ śrīṁ hsphreṁ hsauṁ hskauṁ hsphreṁ śrīṁ hrīṁ aiṁ || ātma pūjā || aiṁ candanaṃ pādukāṃ || hrīṁ akṣataṃ pādukāṃ || śrīvīrabhasmaṃ pādukāṃ || hsphreṁ sarvajanamohanī pādukāṃ || hskauṁ nānācchatrālaṃkālapuṣpaṃ pādukāṃ || aiṁ kusau pādukāṃ (3)|| (******)(?) pūjā || oṃ gaṃgāyai namaḥ || oṃ yamunāyai namaḥ || oṃ narmadāyai namaḥ || oṃ kāveyyai namaḥ || <4b> oṃ kauśaki namaḥ || oṃ gaṇḍakī namaḥ || oṃ sarayū namaḥ || oṃ saptasamudrebhyo namaḥ || oṃ saṃpūrṇakaraṇāyai namaḥ || aiṁ (5)hskṣmlvryūṁ kalavṛkṣamahāsena saṃmohanasakala tīrthamantra devatā kalātatva tatvādhipataya vrahmā viṣṇu rudrātmavidyā śivatatvāyai hskṣmlvryūṁ ānandaśaktibhairavānanda virādhipataye śkṣmlvryīṁ saṃpūrṇa kalaśa murtaye namaḥ || āvāhanāvidhenu mudrāṃ darśayet || (******)(?) mṛta snāna || oṃ adyādi || (**)(?) mānavagotra || yajamānasya śrīśrījayarūpatīndra mallavarvaṇaḥ śrīśrīkulacakreśvarī devatā prītyarthaṃ viśvajātrā mahādīpaprajvalita pañcopacārapūjā katuṃ aviśekaṃ ||
<5a> ūkāraṃ vāyuvijaṃ taduparivaruṇaṃ vajrapāṇinta durddhakālaṃ varṇāntayuktaṃ tadupariparamaṃ vahnivījaṃ sahasaṃ | induṃ vinduṃ layāntaṃ śitakamalavaraṃ kṣīradhārā śravantaṃ dṛṣṭvākuṭantu nityaṃ dahatikulamalaṃ melutubhyaṃ hi pāpaṃ || dudu || payasā (*)(?) tapūnena pṛthivyāṃ paripūritaṃ || kāmadhyenu śravannityaṃ snāpayāmi śivājñayā || (**)(?) || dadhi umāpatiṃ devaṃ devānāmati vallabhaṃ || vācchārkapaṭala sthānaṃ yena snānena labhyate || ghera || <5b> ghṛtaputaṃ vinākena liṃgaputaṃ pinākiṇi || agniśakti svarupeṇa tārtilokācanaṃ śivaṃ || ka(?) sti || gomukhī vipinobhūtaṃ devānāṃ priyamurtamaṃ || vācchā kalpataru snānaṃ yena snānena labhyate || sākha (*)(?) || khaṇḍametat mahāsvādu manasāḥ śītalaṃ sadā || khaṇḍendu snāpitaṃ devaṃ akhaṇḍitavalapradā || paṃcāmṛta || tathā paṃcādi payasaṃ paṃcavrahmā nivāsinaṃ || paṃcadravya samāyuktaṃ paṃcāgaiḥ snāpayāmyahaṃ || alisnāna śkṣmlvryīṁ pādukāṃ || (**)(?) ||
<6a> śrīkhaṇḍacandanaṃ divyaṃ gaṃdhādyasya manoharaṃ || ābhūṣitaṃ lalāṭaṅge candanaṃ prati gṛhyatāṃ || candanaṃ llepitaṃ puṇyaṃ pavitraṃ pāpanāśanaṃ āpadāharate nityaṃ lakṣmīrājya sukhapradāṃ || siṃdhara || vīreśvarī mahāvīra vīrabhasmavibhūṣitaṃ | trailokyā karṣaṇīdevī sindulāruṇamurtamaṃ || akṣata || akṣataṃ akṣayokāmaṃ dharmakāmārtha siddhidaṃ | ispitaṃ mevaraṃ devī paratre ca parāṅgatiṃ || dṛṣṭi || dhyānadṛṣṭi viśāleṣu lalitaṃ vīra cakṣuṣu || somasuryāgni bhuvanaṃ vaisamaṃ netra nirmalaṃ || yajamakā || <6b> yajñopavitaṃ paramaṃ pavitraṃ pajāprateryahatsajapurastāt āyuṣāgandha pratimacaṇḍatraṃ yajñopavitaṃ paramastuteja || aduvāra || nānāvastravicitrāṅgaṃ kṣaumakāryāsa nirmitaṃ | devāṅgaṃ bhūṣaṇaśreṣṭhaṃ gṛhāṇaparameśvaraṃ || (***) ḍhe || cchatraṃ cintāmaṇiṃ divyaṃ pūrṇacandra nibhaṃsitaṃ || tena dartena deveśadehime cintitaṃ phalaṃ || (**)(?) || nānāpuṣpa sugandhādi māratī kusumodayaṃ saubhāgya siddhidaṃ bhadre puṣpārohanamurtamaṃ || pañcapatākā || patākāpañcavarṇābhā karṇayoḥ parilamvinī | paṃcabhūtātmikāpaṃca dartayaṃ k'umanirmitā ||
<7a> karṇapatākā || śurddhaṃ siṃdulavarṇābhāṃ patākāṃ karṇasaṃjñekāṃ || gṛhāṇaparameśāna catuḥkoṇā suśobhanā || thvatendrāyalaye (?) || pitacūnanamālakva coyajāpūjāvoya || tritatvanācanaṃ (?) || oṃ hrāṁ ātmatatvāya svāhā || oṃ hrīṁ vidyātatvāya svāhā || oṃ hrūṁ śivatatvāya svāhā || sūryārgha || adyādi || vākya || gharṇāntaṃ vijamuddhṛtya tasyopari śivaṃ nyaset || ādimadhyā vasāne tu magni (**)(?) vibhūṣitaṃ || varmaṇādipitaṃ kṛtvā sāvitryā caiva murddharet || eṣakuṭavaraḥ śreṣṭo mahāmārtaṇḍabhairava || <7b> arghannamaḥ puṣpannamaḥ || śkṣrīṁ śrīmahāmārtaṇḍabhairavāya namaḥ || guru namaskāra || aiṁ (5)akhaṇḍamaṇḍalākāraṃ vyāptaṃ yena carācaraṃ | tat padaṃ darśitaṃ yena tasmai śrīguruve namaḥ || guruvrahmā guruviṣṇu gurudeva maheśvara || gurudeva jagat sarvaṃ tasmaiśrī guruve namaḥ || paramagurubhyo namaḥ || parameṣṭhī gurubhyo namaḥ || paramācārya gurubhyo namaḥ || valisaḥ || padmāsanāya namaḥ || tha (**)(?) kūrmasanāya namaḥ || javakhava kiṇi (2)vicce koṅkaṇāyai hraḥ astrāya phaṭ ||
<8a> aiṁ hūṁ phaṭ vajrapaṃjare svāhā || calamakulekulamacale hrīṁ hūṁ phaṭ svāhā || tato nyāsaḥ || aṁ ṣustrāya phaṭ || śaṁ kaniṣṭhāya namaḥ || śiṁ anāmikāya svāhā || śūṁ madhyamāya voṣaṭ || śaiṁ tarjanyāya hūṁ || śauṁ aṃguṣṭhāya vaṣaṭ || śaṁ karatarapṛṣṭhāya phaṭ || śeṁ hṛdayāya namaḥ || śīṁ śirase svāhā || śūṁ śikhāya voṣaṭ || śeṁ kavacāya hūṁ || śoṁ netratrayāya vaṣaṭ || āṁ artrāya phaṭ || aṁ astrāya phaṭ 4 || karasodhanaṃ || aiṁ aṃguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ || hrīṁ tarjanībhyāṃ namaḥ || śrīṁ madhyamābhyāṃ namaḥ || hsphreṁ anāmikābhyāṃ namaḥ || hskauṁ kaniṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ || <8b> aṃ astrāya karatalapṛṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ || aiṁ hṛdayāya namaḥ || hrīṁ śirase svāhā || śrīṁ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ || hsphreṁ kavacāya hūṃ || hsauṁ netratrayāya vauṣaṭ || aṃ astrāya phaṭ || iti karāṅgaṃ nyāsa || (**)(?) ṇī nyāsaḥ || aiṁ (5)kiṇi (2)vicce koṅkaṇāyai hraḥ astrāya phaṭ || 4 || karaśodhanaṃ || aiṁ (5)namobhagavati hṛt kamalāyai hrāṁ aṃguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ || (5)hsphreṁ kubjikāyai kuladīpāyai hrīṁ tarjanībhyāṃ namaḥ || hrāṁ hrīṁ hrūṁ varvaraśikhāyai hrūṁ madhyamābhyāṃ namaḥ || (5)ghore aghore aghorāmukhi vahurupāyai anāmikābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
<9a> (5)cchāṁ cchīṁ mahantārikāyai hrauṁ kaniṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ || (5)kiṇi (2)vicce koṅkaṇāyai hraḥ karatalapṛṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ || karanyāsaḥ || (5)namobhagavati hṛtkamalāyai śrīūrddhavaktrāya namaḥ || (5)hsphreṁ kuvjikāyai kuladīpāyai pūrvavaktrāya namaḥ || (5)hrāṁ hrīṁ hrūṁ varvara śikhāyai dakṣinavaktrāya namaḥ || (5)ghore aghore aghorāmukhī vahurupāyai śrīuttaravaktrāya namaḥ || cchāṁ cchīṁ mahantārikāyai śrīpaścimavaktrāya namaḥ || (5)kiṇi (2)vicce koṅkaṇāyai śrīparāparavaktrāya namaḥ || vaktrāṃ nyāsaḥ || (5)namo bhagavati hṛt kamalāyai hrāṁ hṛdayāya namaḥ || <9b> hsphreṁ kuvjikāyai kuladīpāyai hrīṁ śirase svāhā || hrāṁ hrīṁ hrūṁ varvara śikhyāyai hrūṁ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ || ghore aghore aghorāmukhī vahurūpāyai hraiṁ kavacāya hūṃ || cchāṁ cchīṁ mahantārikāyai hrauṁ netratrayāya vauṣaṭ || kiṇi (2)vicce koṅkaṇāyai hraḥ astrāya phaṭ || aṃganyāsaḥ || jalapātra pūjā || jalapātrāsanāya namaḥ || hskṣmlvryūṁ ānandaśaktibhairavānanda vīrādhipataye śkṣmlvryīṁ śrījapātra bhaṭṭārikāyai pādukāṃ || hrāṁ hṛdayādi || āvāhanādi dhenumudrāṃ || gāyatrī||
<10a> (5)kuvjikāyai vidmahe kuladīpāyai dhīmahe tannoḥ kuvji pracodayāt || ātmādi sarva dravyāṇi prokṣayet || atha arghapātra pūjā || pūranaṃ || arghapātrā snāya namaḥ || trikūtamudrā yācorodanaṃ || aghorāstra || (5)hrāṁ hrīṁ hrūṁ hraḥ prasphura (2)ghora (2)taratanurūpavata (2)pracaṭa (2)kaha (2)vama (2)dama (2)ghātaya (2)vighātaya (2)vighni hūṁ (3)phaṭ kroṁ śrīmahākaumārikā vicce pādukāṃ || aiṁ (5)śkṣmlvryīṁ ānandaśakti śrīmahāvidyā rajeśvarī hskṣmlvryūṁ śrīarghapātrabhaṭṭārikāyai pādukāṃ || <10b> glūṁ gaganaratnāya namaḥ || slūṁ svargaratnāya namaḥ || mlūṁ mabhyaratnāya namaḥ || plūṁ pātāralatnāya namaḥ || nlūṁ nāgarantārya namaḥ || mūramantranatriyāñjali (3)|| hrāṁ hṛdayādi || āvāhanādi || pañcamudrāṃ padaśayet || bhutaśuddhi || yaṁ soṣṭhanaṃ || raṁ dahanaṃ || vaṁ pāvanaṃ || laṃ jalamayaṃ || haṃ śṛṣṭirubhavaṃ || kṣaṁ cetanyā mayaṃ || kacchapa mudrāṃ || aiṁ hrīṁ śrīṁ hsphreṁ hsauṁ hsauṁ hsphreṁ śrīṁ hrīṁ aiṁ || ātmapūjā || (5)hskṣmlvryūṁ śkṣmlvryīṁ ātmane aiṁ candanaṃ pādukāṃ || hrīṁ akṣata pādukāṃ || śrīvīrabhasma pādukāṃ || hsphreṁ sarva janamohanī pādukāṃ || hsauṁ nānācchatra araṃkārapuṣpaṃ pādukāṃ ||
